company_name: Shenzhen Hiner Advanced Materials Technology Co.,Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company specializes in polymer anti-static and conductive modified materials, which are relevant for semiconductor manufacturing and assembly processes.
summary: Shenzhen Hiner Advanced Materials Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the R&D, production, and sales of polymer materials, including anti-static and conductive modified materials. The company provides specialized injection molding products and has established collaborations with domestic universities and foreign enterprises to enhance its offerings in the semiconductor sector.

regional_presence.China: The company has established long-term cooperative relationships with various domestic customers.
